title: Über die Bausteine der mathematischen Logik

primary_sources.page_mapping: PDF 1 is digitization cover; PDF 2–13 are journal 305–316
primary_sources.inspection: All 12 journal-page images visually read; formula and footnote checking used rendered images, not cover-only text extraction.
primary_sources.redistribution: No PDF, scan image, or full translation is included in this repository.

historical_boundaries: Original C is modern K; original T is modern C; original Z is modern B.
Page 313 explicitly does not supply a complete general elimination proof.
Page 315 footnote 5 attributes the following discussion beginning at Dagegen to the editor; it does not attribute all of section 6 to Behmann.
Page 316 discusses restricted definition-based correspondence, not arbitrary semantic equivalence or a decision procedure.
reconstruction: Modern bracket abstraction, structural induction, Python term rewriting, finite semantic U models, and exercises are original pedagogical additions.
notebook_execution: Eight ordinary Python code cells executed sequentially by the included stdlib compile/exec runner; no Jupyter kernel was used.
